name: Shimizu Ayumi
source: Ayumi and Takayuki have known each other their entire lives. While he went away after high school, Ayumi immediately started working as a maid at the Yamano's inn. She's an extremely shy girl, and she always seems to defer to the wishes of others, especially Takayuki.
